unruled:aqee#1.1.evidence: i8863 p. 4, Qualified Education Expenses. aqee.inst is bound from dependent.edu_inst / person.edu_inst, whose question says 'paid in 2025 for this student, by anyone', 'for academic periods beginning in 2025 or in the first 3 months of 2026', includes nonacademic fees 'that must be paid to the institution as a condition of enrollment or attendance', says 'Use the amounts actually paid, which may differ from Form 1098-T box 1', and excludes 'amounts paid in 2024 or 2026', room and board, insurance, 'medical expenses (including student health fees)', transportation, and sports, games, hobby or noncredit courses unless part of the degree program 'or, where this student can't get the American opportunity credit, it helps the student acquire or improve job skills'. Every exclusion and inclusion the claim lists is in the question.

unruled:aqee#1.2.evidence: i8863 p. 4, Student qualifications 6 and 7. dependent.edu_line27 is computed only when dependent.edu_aoc; dependent.edu_aoc requires dependent.edu_student, which requires dependent.edu_student_tin -> dependent.edu_1098t ('Did the student receive a 2025 Form 1098-T ...', with the not-required exceptions and the request-and-cooperate procedure), and ends in dependent.edu_aoc_tin, which requires dependent.edu_ein ('Do you have the educational institution's employer identification number (EIN)'). person.edu_* likewise. A No to either leaves line 27 zero.

unruled:aqee#1.3.evidence: i8863 pp. 4, 9. The aqee definition computes both worksheet paths, but the callers choose one: dependent.edu_line27 to 30 take the AOC path only when dependent.edu_aoc, and dependent.edu_line31 takes ws4_llc only when dependent.edu_llc ('an eligible student who is not an American opportunity credit student'), else zero. One student never gets both.

unruled:carloan#1.1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 109-110, "In order to take the QPVLI deduction, you must include the vehicle identification number (VIN) ... on your tax return", substitute VIN for a lemon-law replacement, "Enter the VIN(s) of the APV(s) on line 22, column (i)", attached statement for more than two VINs (quotes checked). The VIN, the substitute VIN and the statement are what is written on or attached to the return; no amount depends on them. unruled:clcw_next_year#1.1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10, 'If you excluded canceled debt from income in 2025, see Pub. 4681.' Canceled debt excluded from income is a Yes to s1.cod_unsupported ('it was canceled in a bankruptcy case or while you ... were insolvent, or is otherwise excluded from income (Form 982 ...)'), asked under s1.cod_any of every filer, which refuses s1.cod_refused. No attribute reduction of the carryovers arises on a return the tool prepares. As the earlier clcw#1.1 ruling, rechecked.

unruled:clcw_next_year#1.2.evidence: p550 p. 103; i1040sd p. 10, 'can be deducted only on the return of the spouse who actually had the loss.' The 2025 side is refused: clcw.spouse_screen asks whether 'the 2024 return these figures come from was a joint return, and for 2025 you are not filing a joint return with the same spouse' and refuses clcw.line1. Separate returns are now prepared (s3.mfs is gone), and this screen, not s3.mfs, is what refuses a 2025 separate return after a 2024 joint one. The carryover figured here (clcw_next_year) is the 2025 return's own carryover; dividing it if the spouses file separately in 2026 is a 2026 return's question and changes no 2025 amount.

unruled:dcprov#1.1.evidence: i2441 pp. 2-3, Line 1. The provider's name and address, the employer's name in column (a), the box above line 1 with its statement for providers beyond three, and 'none' in column (a) are entries on the form that change no amount; dcprov is a collection of any number of providers, and the data model has no strings. As the earlier dcprov#1 ruling, rechecked against the current dcprov lines (one, tin_kind, household, paid, related, see_statement).

unruled:f1095a#1.1.evidence: i8962 pp. 15, 17. f8962.married_this_year asks 'Did you and your spouse marry during 2025, and was anyone in your tax family enrolled in a Marketplace plan before your first full month of marriage?'; f8962.marriage takes it on a joint return and refuses lines 24 and 25 (f8962.yaml refusal 'when: f8962.marriage'), so the pre-marriage column B addition (including the December case) never meets a computed return. unruled:f1095a#1.2.evidence: i8962 p. 16; p974 p. 27. f8962.shared_policy asks whether a Marketplace plan covered 'both a person on this return and a person who is not on it, such as a former spouse, your husband or wife if you file separately, or a child someone else claims'; f8962.alloc refuses, so no Part IV allocation of column A arises. f8962.not_lawful ('Was anyone covered by the Marketplace plan not lawfully present') feeds f8962.other, which also refuses.

unruled:f1095a#1.3.evidence: i8962 p. 16. As f1095a#1.2 for column B: f8962.alloc refuses a shared policy, and f8962.not_lawful (through f8962.other) refuses an enrollee not lawfully present.

unruled:f1095a#1.4.evidence: i8962 p. 17. f8962.alloc refuses a shared policy (no allocated APTC arises); f8962.no_family ('Did the Marketplace make advance payments for someone who is on no one's 2025 tax return') feeds f8962.other, which refuses lines 24 and 25. A Form 1095-A sent to someone else is to be entered: the $f1095a question says 'Count a plan someone else signed up for too, even if its form went to them (ask them for a copy)'.

unruled:f1116col#1.1.evidence: i1116 pp. 9-10. The claim that nothing reads the worksheet is wrong: f1116.must_adjust tests qdcg.line5 above zero and qdcg.line23 below qdcg.line24 (or Schedule D Tax Worksheet lines 18, 45 and 46); f1116.exception applies f1116.exception_ceiling ($197,300 single, head of household and married filing separately, $394,600 joint; eval /tmp/xrr/rinv/mfs.json shows 19730000 for mfs) and the $20,000 test on all foreign dividends of the columns (amb.2025.f1116_exception, which can only refuse more); a return that must adjust and has no exception refuses at f1116.adjust (fixtures f1116.c6_adjust_ceiling and c7_adjust_20000, evaluated: refused at f1116.adjust). Line 1a is unadjusted only when no adjustment is required or the exception is taken. Foreign capital gain distributions refuse at f1116.foreign_gain; the AMT refuses at s2.amt (Form 6251); counting Form 4952 line 4g dividends in f1116.div_total can only fail the $20,000 test and refuse.

unruled:f1116col#1.2.evidence: i1116 pp. 17-18. Line 4b: f1116.asset_method refuses when gross foreign income is over $5,000 (f1116.foreign_over) and there is student loan interest (s1.line21), Schedule 1-A car loan interest (s1a.line30) or itemized investment interest (sa.line9) (fixture f1116.c4_asset_method, evaluated: refused at f1116.asset_method); at $5,000 or less all interest may go to U.S. income (i1116 p. 18). Line 2: f1116.itemized_unread refuses an itemizer with state or local income tax on Schedule A line 5a (fixture f1116.c4_state_income_tax, evaluated: refused there); a non-itemizer has none to enter. Line 5: the columns hold only dividends and interest (non-negative), and foreign capital losses refuse at f1116.foreign_gain. Lines 2, 4b and 5 are zero only on returns that pass these refusals.

unruled:f1116col#1.3.evidence: i1116 p. 17, Lines 3a and 3b. Line 3c is defined on the form, not the column: f1116.line3c adds f1116.line3a and f1116.line3b; f1116.line3a is the standard deduction (f1040.line12e, sa.deduction, which holds no Schedule 1-A amount) for a non-itemizer and Schedule A lines 4 and 5e for an itemizer; f1116.line3b is Schedule 1 line 26 (Part II adjustments) less line 21 (student loan interest, interest expense for line 4b) (amb.2025.f1116_3b_items). The Schedule 1-A line 37 senior deduction is on Form 1040 line 13b and enters neither. f1116col.line3g_figured prorates f1116.line3c by f1116col.line3d over f1116.line3e.

unruled:f1116col#1.4.evidence: cfr-26-1-904-4 p. 4, (c)(3), 'passive income is not treated as subject to a withholding tax ... when a credit is disallowed in full for such foreign tax, for example, under section 901(k)'. ftc.taxes asks the creditable tax 'leaving out tax withheld on a dividend from stock held fewer than 16 days', while the column asks the box 7 amount 'as reported'; when a section 901(k) tax is left out the two differ and f1116.tax_mismatch refuses line 35 (eval /tmp/xrr/rinv/k901.json: ftc.taxes $500, column $600, refused at f1116.tax_mismatch). Income bearing only a non-withholding foreign tax is not on a prepared return (see f1116#1.4: f1116.not_on_statement).

unruled:f1116col#1.5.evidence: i1116 p. 11; cfr-26-1-904-4 p. 4. The claim that no item allocates deductions or tests the groups is wrong: f1116.exp_hi and f1116.exp_lo apportion line 3c and the home mortgage interest to the 15-percent-or-more and under-15-percent groups by gross income over line 3e, f1116.net_hi/net_lo take the net income, f1116.limit_hi/limit_lo apply 37 percent (f1116.high_tax_rate), and f1116.high_taxed refuses line 35 when either group's tax exceeds its limit (fixture f1116.c3_htko_over, evaluated: refused at f1116.high_taxed), so no HTKO column is needed on a prepared return. The test uses unadjusted gross income, before the 904(b) adjustments. With ratable apportionment a group's deductions exceed its income only when all groups are at zero, so the (c)(2)(ii) reallocation moves nothing (amb.2025.f1116_high_taxed).

unruled:f1116sb#1.1.evidence: i1116 p. 19, Line 10; p514 p. 38, 'you must reduce the amount of any carryback or carryforward by the amount that you would have used had you chosen to claim a credit rather than a deduction in that year.' f1116sbyr.amount takes line 8 of the 2024 Schedule B; f1116sb.prior_year is asked only when a 2025 carryover is generated (f1116sb.prior_year_if_excess); f1116sb.changed names carrybacks, redeterminations and audits. A carryover through a 2024 deduction or election year is neither reduced nor refused.

unruled:f1116sb#1.2.evidence: p514 p. 39. f1116sb.split asks 'Is any of the foreign tax carried into 2025 from a joint return of an earlier year, when this return is not a joint return with the same spouse?' and refuses through f1116sb.split_if_carry. Case (a), a separate 2025 return with tax carried through a joint year: the year before 2025 that held it was a joint return when the joint year is 2024 (a Yes, refused); when a separate year came after the joint year, the allocation was made on that separate return's Schedule B, whose line 8 is what f1116sbyr.amount takes. Case (b), joint origin and joint 2025 through separate years: each spouse's 2024 separate Schedule B already holds the allocated amounts, and f1116sbyr.amount's help says 'On a joint return, add your spouse's amount for the same year', which is the combining rule the claim says is missing.

unruled:f1116sb#1.3.evidence: p514 p. 38, reduction of carryovers 'to or from the tax year of the debt cancellation' for debt excluded in bankruptcy or insolvency. A 2025 exclusion is a Yes to s1.cod_unsupported ('canceled in a bankruptcy case or while you ... were insolvent, or is otherwise excluded from income (Form 982 ...)'), which refuses. A reduction made for a 2024 cancellation is made on the 2024 return's Form 982 and reflected in its carryovers.

unruled:f1116sbyr#1.1.evidence: i1116sb p. 1, Line 2. f1116sb.changed ('Since you filed your 2024 return, has anything changed the foreign tax carried from it, such as a carryback that differs from its estimate, a change in foreign tax for an earlier year, or an audit?') is asked whenever a carryover is claimed (f1116sb.changed_if_carry) and refuses f1116.line35 ('an adjustment on line 2 of Schedule B (Form 1116), which this tool does not figure'). Line 2 is empty only on returns without an adjustment. A carryback with no estimate and a correction of the 2024 line 8 are not named: BUG-0834 (2).

unruled:f2441#1.1.evidence: i2441 p. 2; p503 pp. 3, 8, 10, quoted. Column (d) is not a raw total: it is dependent.dc_paid, asked per qualifying person, and its interview prompt states each rule the claim lists: care 'for the time this person was under 13 or not able to care for themselves' (status day by day; a child turning 13 is also asked dependent.dc_under13 and dependent.dc_over12_care); 'your share of the employment taxes'; the housekeeper's meals; leave out 'school from kindergarten up, summer school, tutoring and overnight camp', 'food, lodging, clothing, schooling and entertainment, unless food or schooling comes with the care and cannot be separated', 'amounts a state social services agency paid back to you, and expenses you claim as medical expenses', 'child support', 'a chauffeur, bartender or gardener', care outside the home for anyone but a dependent child under 13 who does not spend 8 hours a day in the home, 'a care center that does not meet all state and local rules'; days of work only, and 'If a cost was only partly for work, count that part'. f2441.other_care_expenses (line 16 inputs) asks only for 2025 care not in the per-person amounts, i.e. care of the same kind. The reviewer saw the f2441 lines, not the dependent entry's question.

unruled:f2441#1.2.evidence: i2441 p. 1, Qualifying Person(s), 'Your disabled spouse who wasn't physically or mentally able to care for themselves and lived with you for more than half the year'. The tool never counts a spouse as a qualifying person: f2441.unable ('In 2025, was there a time when you (or, on a joint return, your spouse) could not care for yourself ...', help 'Answer Yes too if some of the care you paid for was for your husband or wife. A Yes ends the interview here.') feeds f2441.student_disabled, which refuses on lines 4, 5, 18 and 19 ('... and a disabled spouse as a qualifying person, are outside this tool'). On a separate return the help still names care for the husband or wife. Other qualifying persons are dependents tested by dependent.dc_lived_half (dependent.dc_disabled_qp), so the half-year test is applied where the tool computes.

unruled:f2441#1.3.evidence: i2441 p. 3, Column (b), quoted; p503 p. 3. A qualifying person must be the filer's dependent (dependent.dc_qp requires dependent.claimed; a non-dependent qualifying person is refused at f2441.nondependent_gate). dependent.tin asks for an 'SSN, ITIN or ATIN issued on or before the due date ... or have you applied for an ITIN or ATIN', and dependent.claimed refuses through dependent.claimed_no_tin ('Each dependent must be listed with an SSN (or ITIN or ATIN) ... A dependent child who was born and died in 2025 without an SSN, entered as "Died" ... is outside this tool'). The column (c) box is encoded: dependent.dc_line2c from dependent.dc_over12_care and dependent.dc_incapable. dependent.dc_count's cite records the TIN route.

unruled:f2441#1.4.evidence: i2441 p. 3, Column (c), quoted. dcprov.tin_kind (printed 1(c)) is an enum with tin, tax_exempt ('enter "Tax-Exempt"'), lafcp ('enter "LAFCP"'), see_statement and employer; the interview offers the same five answers. The 'none' entry on line 1 column (a) for a filer completing only Part III is a name column, which the dcprov note says is written by the filer and not modelled; presentation only, no amount.

unruled:f4137#1.1.evidence: f4137 p. 2, Line 1, Columns (c) and (d), 'include any allocated tips ... shown on your Form(s) W-2, box 8, unless you can prove that your unreported tips are less'. Allocated tips are refused: s2.w2_marks (asked of every filer with a W-2, 'Does any have an amount in box 8 ...'; help 'Box 8 is tips the employer assigned to you ... A Yes ends the interview here') makes s2.other true, which refuses. Report timing is covered: f4137row.col_c help 'Tips reported in January 2026 for December 2025 count in 2026, not here'; f4137row.col_d help 'Count tips reported late for 2025 too'. December 2024 tips reported timely in January 2025 fall out of both columns (c) and (d) under the questions' wording, so lines 2 and 3 are both lower and line 4 and the tax are unchanged (presentation only).

unruled:f4137#1.2.evidence: f4137 p. 2, Columns (c) and (d), timely and late reporting. f4137row.col_d help 'Count tips reported late for 2025 too' (late tips belong to the year earned); f4137row.col_c help 'Tips reported in January 2026 for December 2025 count in 2026, not here' (timely January report moves the tips to 2026). The remaining case, December 2024 tips reported timely in January 2025, drops out of both columns (c) and (d) together, so line 4 (c minus d), line 6 and the tax do not change.

unruled:f4137#1.3.evidence: f4137 p. 2, 'the $20 rule applies separately to the tips you received while working for each employer'. person.f4137_under20 asks for tips not reported 'because the tips at one job came to less than $20 in a calendar month', and its interview help says 'in a month in which the cash and card tips at that job came to $20 or more'; the test is per employer as the source says.

unruled:f4137#1.4.evidence: f4137 p. 1, 'If you believe you're an employee and you received Form 1099-MISC ... don't use this form'. Form 4137 takes only tips per employer (f4137row.col_c/col_d, reached through scope.tips_unreported 'Tips not reported in full to an employer'); no question puts Form 1099 pay there. Pay from a firm that treated the filer as a contractor is asked by scope.contractor_pay ('did a firm pay you ... as an independent contractor, when you believe you were its employee, without taking out social security or Medicare tax?') and goes to Form 8919 (f8919firm.wages, help 'With a Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC, this is usually its amount').

unruled:f4137row#1.1.evidence: f4137 p. 2, Columns (c) and (d), allocated tips in W-2 box 8; RRTA. Box 8 is refused through s2.w2_marks ('an amount in box 8 ... A Yes ends the interview here'), which makes s2.other refuse. RRTA work is refused on f4137.line8 when person.rrta ('Don't use Form 4137 to report tips received for work covered by the Railroad Retirement Tax Act').

unruled:f4137row#1.2.evidence: f4137 p. 2, Columns (c) and (d), timely and late reporting, 10th-day rule. As f4137#1.2: col_c help moves December 2025 tips reported in January 2026 to 2026, col_d help counts late-reported 2025 tips; the residual December 2024 case moves columns (c) and (d) together and changes no tax. The 10th-day weekend rule is the definition of timely and changes no amount the filer enters beyond that help.

unruled:f4137row#1.3.evidence: f4137 p. 2, Line 1, columns (a) and (b) and the over-five-employers statement. The collection note says 'columns (a) and (b) name the employer and change no amount'; the employer rows are a collection with no limit of five, and lines 2 and 3 total all rows, which is what the attachment rule produces. Names, EINs and the attachment are paper presentation.

unruled:f4562#1.1.evidence: i4562 p. 5, Lines 5 to 12. f4562.line12 copies sc.s179_allowed, the business's share of the return's Part I (s179): s179.line5 with the married-filing-separately 50% share (s179.line5_mfs) and a refusal of any section 179 election or carryover on a separate return (s179.mfs, so the different-allocation election never arises); line 6 sums person.s179_nonlisted (listed property is on line 7); trade-ins are refused by asset.got_other ('Did you get it with a trade-in...') and scveh.got_other; line 10 is the 2024 line 13 carryover (s179.prior_form, s179.carryover); line 11 is s179.income0 from the Schedule C profits figured without section 179 (person.income179) plus Form 1040 line 1a wages, combined for both spouses, with working-capital interest (s179.wc_interest); asset.s179 limits the election to property used in the active conduct of the business. The half-SE-tax and NOL deductions are not in Schedule C net profit. Rechecked against the current lines; same as the earlier ruling.

unruled:f4562#1.10.evidence: i4562 p. 13, Part V, Form 2106 and Schedule C Part IV (quotes checked). Where the vehicle information is reported changes no amount. Form 2106 is an employee form, not a Schedule C business; a Schedule C vehicle on the standard mileage rate is reported in Schedule C Part IV (scveh, line 9), and only an owned vehicle on actual expenses shows Part V lines (scveh.is_actual_owned). Same class as the earlier f4562 presentation rulings (f4562#2.12).

unruled:f4562#1.2.evidence: i4562 p. 9, Line 17, partial dispositions and "Prior years' depreciation, plus current year's depreciation, can never exceed the depreciable basis" (checked). A disposal of part of the asset in 2025 is refused by asset.ended_this_year ('did you sell, give away or scrap it or part of it'); a portion disposed of in an earlier year changed its basis other than by depreciation, refused by asset.basis_changed; both are in asset.screen and refuse through asset.screened. The cap holds by construction: asset.macrs_prior applies the MACRS percentage table rates (which sum to 100%) to the unadjusted basis after section 179 and the allowance (asset.ub_prior), and is zero after the last recovery year (asset.done).

unruled:f4562#1.3.evidence: i4562 pp. 9, 11-12 (quotes checked). What is encoded: the business-use basis (asset.basis from asset.cost x asset.pct), section 179 and the allowance before MACRS (asset.after179, asset.ub), and the mid-quarter 40% test (form mq, mq.applies, with asset.quarter/asset.qconv). What is refused through asset.screen (asset.screened): basis reductions by credits or deductions other than section 179 and the allowance (asset.basis_changed), the straight line and 150% DB elections (asset.method_other), property disposed of in 2025 (asset.ended_this_year), and property acquired in a like-kind exchange or involuntary conversion (asset.got_other). Converted property is placed in service on the conversion date (asset.placed help).

unruled:f4562#1.4.evidence: i4562 p. 11 (quotes checked). Trees and vines bearing fruits or nuts are farm property: their class is outside in class_lives (asset.outside, 'Certain Property for Which Recovery Periods Assigned' and agricultural classes) and farm income is refused by scope.farm. Qualified smart electric meters and smart grid systems are named in asset.industry_item ('qualified smart electric meter or qualified smart electric grid system property'), asked of a utility or energy business (asset.industry), refused through asset.screen.

unruled:f4562#1.5.evidence: i4562 pp. 11-13, ADS and real property (quotes checked). asset.kind_excluded refuses buildings and their parts and land ('Is this a building or part of one, land, ...'); asset.ads_required refuses property that must use ADS and asset.method_other an ADS election; asset.outside_use refuses property used outside the US and tax-exempt use property; all refuse through asset.screened, so lines 19g to 19j and 20a to 20e are never reached for a Schedule C asset. Rental buildings (19h/19i) are depreciated in rprop/rf4562 for Schedule E. Converted property is placed in service on the conversion date (asset.placed help, asset.cost help: smaller of adjusted basis or FMV).

unruled:f4562#1.6.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-14, Line 25 (quotes checked). Listed property whose qualified business use is 50% or less is refused (asset.qbu_low in asset.screen; asset.listed_low; scveh.qbu_low for vehicles), so no allowance is taken on it; aircraft are refused by asset.kind_excluded. Vehicles are scveh entries, whose first-year limits include the special allowance (scveh.lim_first_bonus from table auto_limit) and are reduced by the business-use share.

unruled:f4562#1.7.evidence: i4562 pp. 14-15, Lines 26 and 27 (quotes checked). Encoded for vehicles in scveh: business miles excluding commuting (scveh.miles_business, scveh.miles_commuting), the 50% test (scveh.over_half), the passenger-automobile limits (tables auto_limit, auto_limit_first_nobonus) reduced by the business-use share, the unrecovered basis after the recovery period (scveh.unrecovered, scveh.post), heavy vehicles that are not passenger automobiles (scveh.passenger, scveh.macrs_heavy). Refused by scveh.screen: qualified business use 50% or less after the quoted exclusions, conversion from personal use in 2025, vehicle credits and clean-fuel basis reductions, a vehicle placed in service before 2019, leasing businesses and for-hire use; employees' personal use is refused by scveh.employee_bad. For other listed property, asset.qbu_low and asset.listed_low refuse 50% or less, asset.pct handles converted property by months, and aircraft are refused by asset.kind_excluded.

unruled:f4562#1.8.evidence: i4562 pp. 14-15, line 27 (quotes checked). Listed property used 50% or less in a qualified business use is refused: asset.listed_low gates asset.basis ('Listed property used 50% or less for business is depreciated under ADS and is outside this tool') and asset.qbu_low refuses through asset.screened; vehicles at 50% or less are refused by scveh.qbu_low and scveh.low_use. So line 27 is never needed and line 28 (sc.f28 = sc.f25 + sc.f26h) is complete for the property admitted.

unruled:f4562#1.9.evidence: i4562 pp. 13, 15 (quotes checked). Section 179 on listed property other than vehicles: asset.s179_bad refuses an election on property not used more than 50% in the business, and asset.listed_low refuses listed property at 50% or less. Vehicles: scveh refuses 50% or less (scveh.qbu_low, scveh.low_use), and column (i) for a vehicle is scveh.s179_this_year_o = scveh.line10, the election 'not more than line 9 for a passenger automobile' (the passenger-automobile limit, scveh.s179_line10 = smaller of the election and line 9). Line 29 is sc.f29 = sc.f29_assets + sc.f29_veh.

unruled:f4952#1.1.evidence: f4952 p. 3, 'include capital gain distributions from mutual funds and capital loss carryovers.' f4952.line4d is sd.line16 floored at zero; sd.line16 combines sd.line7 and sd.line15, which include the carryovers on Schedule D lines 6 and 14 (from clcw.line8 and clcw.line13) and the capital gain distributions on line 13. As the earlier f4952#1 ruling, rechecked.

unruled:f5329#1.1.evidence: i5329 p. 5; p590b p. 28. The claim reads only f5329.l2. The dollar caps are applied per person: person.x_cap09 ($10,000 less person.x_prior09), person.x_cap19 ($5,000 per birth, person.x_births), person.x_c05 (medical over 7.5% of AGI), person.x_c22 ($10,300) and person.x_c23 ($1,000), summed in person.x_limited_sum into f5329.l2; the 50%-of-account and interest-minus-$1,000 limits are stated in retirement.exc_amount. The conditions (age 55/50 separation or 25 years of service, plan type, substantially equal payments after separation, disability proof and medical determination, first home no-ownership for both spouses, reservist call-up period, eligible adoptee) are in retirement.exception's question, and retirement.wrong_kind refuses an IRA-only or plan-only exception on the other kind of account; age 59 1/2 with code 1 is exception 12 in the same list. The 3-year emergency bar is refused by retirement.early_screen (retirement.screen_refused), and person.x_two23 refuses exception 23 on more than one distribution. Left: the birth/adoption statement, an attachment (presentation, as retirement#1.5).

unruled:f5329#1.2.evidence: i5329 pp. 5, 7. Earnings on an excess IRA contribution withdrawn by the due date are paid on a Form 1099-R with code 8 or P (with J for a Roth IRA). The retirement entry's question retirement.ira_returned_if_ira ('Was any of this a contribution of yours that the IRA paid back to you, for example because you had put in more than the yearly limit?') feeds retirement.special, which refuses the entry ('Form 1099-R special cases (Forms 5329, 8606, ...)'); a code 8 or P is also 'other' in retirement.code, refused by retirement.bad_code. So no earnings amount reaches line 1 uncomputed. person.ira_trad leaves the withdrawn contribution out of line 11 ('anything you took back out with its earnings by the deadline').

unruled:f5329#1.3.evidence: i5329 p. 1. retirement.bad_code refuses any Roth IRA distribution coded other than Q (account roth_ira and code not qualified_roth_Q), which covers a Form 8606 line 25c amount, a recapture amount and a nonqualified first-home distribution; code J is not in retirement.code's list and is entered as 'other', which bad_code refuses. A code 7 received under 59 1/2 is refused by retirement.code_screen (code7_wrong). The cases left (code 1 alone, code S, an exception, HSA excess) are those f5329.must handles; the must-file test only decides whether Form 5329 is attached, not the Schedule 2 line 8 amount.

unruled:f5329#1.4.evidence: i5329 p. 8. f8889.excess_withdrawn asks 'Did you withdraw from your HSA any excess contributions (yours or your employer's) or the earnings on them, in 2025, or in 2026 by the due date of your 2025 return including extensions, or will you by that date?' and refuses Form 8889 lines 2, 13 and 14b, so a timely withdrawal never reaches line 47. A withdrawal in the 6-month window after a timely filed return is made with an amended return, not this one.

unruled:f7203#1.1.evidence: i7203 p. 1, Who Must File, quoted. Both triggers are refused on the K-1 itself, not behind f7203.required: k1s.basis_carry is asked on every K-1 (no gate; 'Was a loss or deduction from this corporation held back on an earlier return because your basis in it was too low?') and refuses at k1s.ok (Form 7203 Part III column (b)); a loan repayment is box 16 code E, refused through k1s.box16ef_if_16 ('code E (repayment of loans from you)'). Every K-1 also refuses at scope.k1 until the integration lane wires the totals.

unruled:f7203#1.2.evidence: i7203 p. 4, Column (b), quoted. Column (b) is refused, not dropped: k1s.basis_carry (asked on every K-1) refuses with 'Form 7203, Part III, column (b), and Schedule E (Form 1040), line 27'; f7203's note says so.

unruled:f7203#1.3.evidence: i7203 p. 4, column (a), quoted. Lines 39 to 46 take boxes 11 and 12 (section 179, charitable contributions, investment interest, 59(e)(2), other deductions), box 16 code F (foreign taxes) and box 17 code R (oil and gas depletion); each is refused on the K-1: k1s.box11_12, k1s.box16ef_if_16, k1s.box17_other_if_17. The f7203 note states 'Lines 39 to 46 have no amount: the boxes that would fill them are refused on the K-1', so the premise that nothing is noted is wrong.

unruled:f7203#1.4.evidence: i7203 p. 2, Line 2: section 351 'carryover basis of assets transferred ... less the liabilities assumed', section 357(c); 'The basis for stock received as compensation is the FMV on the date the compensation is included in income'. Partly covered: f7203.line2 help gives inherited (value at death) and gifted (giver's basis) shares, and f7203.line1 help covers a first year ('If you first got shares in 2025, enter 0 and give what they cost'). Not covered: property contributed (adjusted basis less liabilities; 357(c)) and stock received for services. Low.

unruled:f7203#1.5.evidence: i7203 p. 2, 'aren't part of a shareholder's loan basis except to the extent the shareholder makes a payment on the loan guaranteed or co-signed'. f7203.loans help says 'Loans you guaranteed or co-signed for the corporation are not meant' with no exception for payments made, so such a shareholder answers No, Part II is not refused, and losses are limited by stock basis alone (understated deduction). Low.

unruled:f7203#1.6.evidence: i7203 p. 2, Name of Shareholder and Item D, quoted. The per-spouse split is already encoded: f7203 is an implicit entry under each k1s entry (collection parent k1s), and each K-1 is issued to one shareholder, so spouses with their own K-1s get their own Form 7203. Item D (how the stock was acquired) is a checkbox with no amount.

unruled:f8606#1.1.evidence: i8606 pp. 2, 9. Line 1 is person.ira_nondeductible, figured from IRA Deduction Worksheet lines 10 to 12 on person.ira_trad, whose question leaves out SEP or SIMPLE contributions and contributions taken back with their earnings by the deadline (help: 'Leave out rollovers, repayments of a reservist distribution, ... anything you took back out with its earnings by the deadline for your return, ... and SEP or SIMPLE contributions'). Recharacterization is refused by person.ira_excess (person.ira_recharacterized); contributions above the limit by person.ira_over_limit and person.ira_extra_left. A repayment of a qualified reservist distribution (to be added to line 1) is refused for the whole return: scope.reservist_repaid ('did you ... put back into an IRA money taken out of a retirement plan during a call to active duty as a reservist?') is in scope.other_income, which refuses Form 1040. The earlier ruling's BUG-0402 residue (reservist repayment) is so closed by that refusal.

unruled:f8606#1.2.evidence: i8606 p. 2. A Roth IRA distribution other than a qualified one (code Q), inherited or not, is refused by retirement.bad_code. A traditional IRA distribution with basis is refused through retirement.special (retirement.ira_basis_if_trad) and f8606.dist; the beneficiary of an inherited IRA with the decedent's basis may answer that question No, which is the open BUG-0871 (see retirement#1.2). The stand-alone Form 8606 for a person not required to file a return is outside a tool that prepares a Form 1040 (no return is filed); presentation only.

unruled:f8863#1.1.evidence: i8863 p. 1, Form 1098-T requirement: every student path requires dependent.edu_1098t or person.edu_1098t (through edu_student_tin), which asks whether a 2025 Form 1098-T was received and states the not-required exception and the request-after-January-31 rule.

unruled:f8863#1.2.evidence: i8863 p. 1: 'If you haven't been issued a TIN by the due date of your 2025 return ... you can't claim the American opportunity credit'; person.edu_aoc_tin uses household.all_tin, which counts an ITIN only applied for, and the student path accepts person.edu_student_itin. The institution's EIN is asked by person.edu_ein.

unruled:f8880#1.1.evidence: f8880 p. 2, Line 2. person.sav_voluntary's question excludes 'contributions designated under section 414(h)(2) (treated as employer contributions)' and cites the note; the elective deferrals of person.sav_w2 come from W-2 box 12 codes (D, E, F, S, AA, BB, EE, and the governmental 457(b) part of G), which do not carry 414(h)(2) pick-ups.

unruled:f8880#1.2.evidence: f8880 p. 2, Who Can Take This Credit. person.sav_student asks 'during any part of 5 calendar months of 2025, were you enrolled as a full-time student at a school, or did you take a full-time, on-farm training course ...? (A school includes technical, trade, and mechanical schools. It does not include on-the-job training courses, correspondence schools, or schools offering courses only through the Internet.)'; person.sav_ineligible, and so f8880.inelig_a / inelig_b, read it.

unruled:f8889#1.1.evidence: i8889 p. 8; i5329 p. 8. A prior-year HSA excess is asked of every person with an HSA by person.x_hsa_prior_excess ('excess HSA contributions from an earlier year ... not removed or used up before 2025'), part of person.x_other. Evaluated: fixture stage11.hsa.self_full_year with person[taxpayer].x_hsa_prior_excess true gives f1040.line24 refused at person[taxpayer].x_other (Form 5329 Parts ... or an earlier-year excess in Part VII). So the line 13 addition is never needed on a completed return.

unruled:f8889#1.2.evidence: p969 pp. 5, 8. Cash only is now covered: f8889.line2 help 'Only money can be put in, not stock or other property' (BUG-0678). Open: the help tells the filer to count deposits 'by you, or by anyone other than your employer' and leave out the employer's; an S corporation's contribution for a 2% shareholder-employee (in W-2 box 1, deductible on line 2) is then left out. Schedule K-1 (Form 1120-S) is now in scope (k1s), so the earlier 'refused elsewhere' reasoning no longer holds; no question or refusal names a 2% shareholder for Form 8889 (sc.hi_screen names one only for the self-employed health insurance deduction). Low.

unruled:f8889#1.3.evidence: p969 pp. 8-9; i8889 p. 8. f8889.medical lists 'long-term care insurance' premiums with no age-based limit (p502 lists $480 to $6,020 for 2025), and says costs must date from after you opened the HSA without the rule that an HSA funded by a rollover is established when the prior account was. The excess withdrawn after the due date is not reachable as a 2025 value (BUG-0678: a 2024 excess is refused by person.x_hsa_prior_excess, a code 2 by f8889.dist_code_if_dist). Low.

unruled:f8889#1.4.evidence: p969 p. 5, Health FSA grace period. f8889.fsa's help now says 'A 2024 health FSA's extra months in early 2025 count only if money was left in it at the end of 2024', so a grace period with a zero prior-year balance is answered No.

unruled:f8889#1.5.evidence: i8889 p. 4, Line 1. The self-only/family checkbox is not encoded, but the amounts it would select are figured from the coverage answers: f8889.coverage_year (self-only all year, family all year, or changed, counted month by month) and f8889.dec_coverage for the last-month rule set line 3. The checkbox changes no amount.

unruled:f8919#1.1.evidence: f8919 p. 1, Who must file. scope.contractor_pay asks the three conditions together: 'did a firm pay you ... as an independent contractor, when you believe you were its employee, without taking out social security or Medicare tax?'; the firms are then listed in f8919firm, each with f8919firm.reason (codes A, C, G, H). The reason help says 'If none of these fits but you believe you were an employee, choose the third and send Form SS-8 to the IRS by the day you file. With the last one, do not send Form SS-8.' So eligibility, the code and the SS-8 rule are asked.

unruled:f8919#1.2.evidence: f8919 p. 2, Line 6, 'Also enter this amount on Form 8959, line 3'. The claim is false: f8959.line3 sums person.f8919_wages over persons ('Wages from Form 8919, line 6'), so line 6 reaches the Additional Medicare Tax. The per-firm columns (a), (b), (d) and (e) are presentation: the f8919firm note says they 'identify the firm and the IRS letter and change no amount'; one code per row is enforced by the single-choice f8919firm.reason.

unruled:f8919firm#1.1.evidence: f8919 p. 1, columns (a), (b), (d), (e). The f8919firm note: 'columns (a), (b), (d) and (e) identify the firm and the IRS letter and change no amount'. The SS-8 point is false: f8919firm.reason help says 'With the last one [code H], do not send Form SS-8.'

unruled:f8919firm#1.2.evidence: f8919 p. 1, 'If married, complete a separate Form 8919 for each spouse'. f8919firm is a collection within person ('For this person (you, or your spouse on a joint return) — Which firms paid you in that way in 2025?'), and f8919 is one per person (note: 'Lines 6 to 13 of one person's Form 8919, from that person's firms'); lines 7 to 10 use that person's own wages, so the wage base is applied per spouse.

unruled:f8959#1.1.evidence: i8959 p. 4, Line 19. Box 12 codes B and N are asked by s2.w2_marks ('Does any Form W-2 ... show an amount in box 8 (allocated tips), or code A, B, K, M, N or Z in box 12?'), part of s2.other. Evaluated: fixture stage4.base (f8959) with s2.w2_marks true gives s2.line21 and f1040.line24 refused at s2.other; without it they compute. So line 19 is never short of a code B or N amount on a completed return.

unruled:f8995#1.1.evidence: i8995 p. 3, quoted. qbi.dividends asks for 'Qualified section 199A dividends from Form 1099-DIV box 5. Leave out the part paid on shares you held for 45 days or less, and the part you are obliged to pay to someone else; enter only the part that qualifies', and its help repeats it; f8995.line6 takes that amount through qbi.eligible. Same as the earlier ruling, rechecked on the current line.

unruled:ftc#1.1.evidence: i1116 p. 2. Deduction instead of credit: sa.foreign_tax_deduct ('Do you want to deduct the foreign taxes ... instead of taking a credit for them?') is asked whenever ftc.has_tax and a Yes sets sa.unsupported, refusing the return (eval /tmp/xrr/rinv/deduct.json: ftc.credit refused at sa.unsupported); on a No, Schedule A line 6 is a constant zero, so the same year's tax is never both credited and deducted (as f1116#1.1). Additional treaty credit for a citizen in a treaty country: the foreign tax is paid by the filer to the residence country, not withheld and reported on a U.S. payee statement; ftc.statements (help 'Answer No if you paid any of the tax to another country yourself') then makes ftc.needs1116 true and f1116.not_on_statement refuses f1116.line35 (eval /tmp/xrr/rinv/nostmt.json).

unruled:g28#1.1.evidence: i1040sd p. 11. sales.special names 'an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust (including S corporation stock) that holds collectibles or section 1250 property directly or through another entity' and refuses the sale (sales.yaml refusal when sales.special), so no look-through collectibles gain or Regulations section 1.1(h)-1(e) statement arises.

unruled:interest#1.1.evidence: i1040sb p. 1. sb.bond_special lists 'have market discount to report', 'a bond whose payments depend on something uncertain (a contingent payment debt instrument)' and 'the buyer of your home or other property pays you interest on the price (a seller-financed mortgage)'; a Yes sets sb.unsupported and refuses. Market discount on a tax-exempt bond is market discount to report; tax-exempt interest is asked separately (f1040.tax_exempt_interest). The buyer's name, address and SSN go with a refused return. As the earlier interest#1.1 and #1.2 rulings.

unruled:ira#1.1.evidence: i1040gi p. 95. person.ira_trad, the source of worksheet line 11, says 'do not include rollover contributions, ... contributions made in 2025 that you deducted for 2024, ... trustees' fees billed separately'; its interview help: 'Leave out rollovers, ... money you deducted on your 2024 return, ... trustee's fees billed separately'.

unruled:ira#1.2.evidence: i1040gi p. 95; p590a p. 35. The claim misses person.ira_over_limit, which refuses when this person's traditional plus Roth contributions exceed $7,000/$8,000, and person.ira_extra_left ('Did you put more into your IRAs for 2025 than you were allowed, and was the extra still there after the deadline ...?'). Evaluated: fixture stage16.refuse.person.ira_over_limit gives s1.line20 refused at person[taxpayer].ira_over_limit. Earnings on a withdrawn excess are refused through retirement.special (see f5329#1.2).

unruled:ira#1.3.evidence: i1040gi p. 96. A Form 8815 exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported ('a savings bond interest exclusion'); excluded employer-provided adoption benefits by scope.other_income (scope.adoption_benefits_if_adoption: 'Did an employer pay or repay any of the adoption costs ...? Box 12 of a W-2 shows it with the code T.').

unruled:ira#1.4.evidence: i1040gi p. 96, 'If you are married filing separately and you lived apart from your spouse for all of 2025, check the box on line 20.' Separate returns are now in scope, so the earlier s3.mfs ruling no longer holds. The lived-apart answer is asked and used (deemed coverage and the line 2 amount, as the claim says); no line produces the Schedule 1 line 20 checkbox (only ssb.lived_apart produces the line 6d box). The box changes no amount; it is a mark on the printed form.

unruled:ltc#1.1.evidence: i7206 p. 2. sc.hi_screen asks, for each business's health insurance, whether 'one person's long-term care insurance is entered under more than one business on this return' ('A Yes is outside what this tool prepares'); sc.hi_screened refuses sc.f7206_line1, so one person's age limit is applied on one Form 7206 only.

unruled:ltc#1.2.evidence: i7206 p. 1. sc.hi_screen names 'you are a retired public safety officer and paid premiums out of retirement plan payments' and sc.hi_screened refuses; the same exclusion on Form 1099-R (retirement.pso_exclusion) is refused by retirement.special.

unruled:mq#1.1.evidence: p946 p. 34. mq.q4 sums person.mq_q4 = sc.mq_q4 (assets and vehicles), each asset's from asset.mqbase = asset.after179 (business-use basis less section 179, before the special allowance; personal use is excluded because asset.basis is business/investment use only). Real property, same-year dispositions, non-MACRS methods, films and other excluded property are refused by asset.screen ('it is real property (a building or a structural component, other than qualified improvement property) or land', 'you disposed of it ... in 2025', 'you depreciate it by a method other than the MACRS percentage tables'). Form 1040 here is the calendar-year 2025 return, so the last 3 months are October to December.

unruled:mq#1.2.evidence: p946 p. 34. As mq#1.1: mq.total sums asset.mq_total (asset.mqbase for property placed in service in 2025) and the vehicle bases; the excluded property is refused by asset.screen and the basis rule is asset.after179.

unruled:mq#1.3.evidence: p946 p. 34. Nonresidential real property, residential rental property and railroad grading or tunnel bores never reach mq.applies: Schedule C real property is refused by asset.screen ('it is real property ... or land'); rental buildings are rprop entries depreciated with the mid-month tables (rprop.rate, Table A-6/A-7a) and are not in mq.q4 or mq.total, which sum Schedule C assets and vehicles only.

unruled:oi8z#1.1.evidence: p525 p. 32, Court awards and damages: the medical-care exception for non-physical emotional distress, the pre-September 13, 1995 agreements, and attorney fees included in income. For kind taxable_damages, oi8z.injury asks only about a physical injury or sickness (Yes refuses); with No, oi8z.amount asks 'How much of it is income for 2025?' with no help on these rules, so the medical-care part may be taxed and an award net of a contingent fee may be understated. Low.

unruled:oi8z#1.2.evidence: p525 pp. 32-34: credit card insurance benefits net of premiums, a free tour at FMV, sale of an expected inheritance. None is one of the five prepared kinds of oi8z.kind (RTAA, kickbacks, fiduciary fees, found property, taxable damages); each is 'Something else' (other), and oi8z.figured is true for kind other, which refuses ('Line 8z items other than RTAA payments and kickbacks are outside this tool'); oi8z.kind help says choosing any other kind ends the interview.

unruled:qdcg#1.1.evidence: i1040gi p. 38, line 2 footnote (Form 2555). sa.excluded_income ('did you ... live or work abroad, in Puerto Rico or in American Samoa, and leave the income you earned there out of this return?'; help: 'These are the exclusions of Form 2555 ... A Yes ends the interview here') refuses every Form 2555 filer, so the Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet never applies.

unruled:qdcg#1.2.evidence: i1040gi p. 38, line 3. The Form 2555 footnote: refused by sa.excluded_income as in qdcg#1.1. The Form 1040 line 7b box ('be sure you checked the box') is a checkbox on the printed return and changes no amount; line 3 takes Form 1040 line 7a.

unruled:rec#1.1.evidence: i1040gi p. 92, Line 8z, 'List the type and amount of income. If necessary, include a statement'. The description and statement are filing information; rec.to_line8z gives the amount, which is what line 8z adds.

unruled:rf4562#1.1.evidence: i1040se p. 7, Line 18: Form 4562 is needed for listed property, a section 179 deduction or amortization beginning in 2025. Each case is refused before rf4562.needed matters: a vehicle at rental.vehicle ('Car, truck or travel costs for it', refuses at rental.line21_full); any other listed property is personal property, refused at rprop.personal; a section 179 deduction or special allowance at rprop.screen ('you deducted any of its cost in one year (a special allowance or section 179) or depreciate it another way'). Amortization: no rental cost the encoding takes is amortized on Form 4562 (points on a rental loan are interest under p527, OID rules, not Form 4562 amortization); a startup-type amortization does not arise in a Schedule E Part I rental of the kinds kept. Effect presentation only (whether the form is attached).

unruled:rf4562#1.2.evidence: i1040se p. 7; i4562 p. 9, Line 17. rprop.screen refuses 'you sold, gave away or stopped renting it in 2025' (use ended, partial disposition) and 'its basis changed after you began depreciating it, other than by depreciation', and ADS or other methods. Prior depreciation cannot exceed basis under the tables used: eval of x1sche.f2.small_loss_exception with the building placed in service February 1997, 1996, 1990 and before 1987 gives rprop.recovery_year 29, 30, 36, 40 and rprop.rate 0, rprop.dep $0 (the recovery period has ended), so line 17 takes nothing beyond the basis.

unruled:rf4562#1.3.evidence: i1040se p. 7; i4562 p. 9. Land: rprop.basis asks 'what you paid for the building or improvement, not the land', with help 'the price (with closing costs) less the part for the land; your property tax bill's split of land and building may be used' (covered). Placed in service: rprop.month/rprop.year ask when 'it was first ready and available for rent (placed in service)' (covered). Like-kind exchange or involuntary conversion in 2025 (the carryover-basis rule and its election): trading real estate or rental property is sd.sold_other and sd.business_property, and a condemnation or casualty is on sd.other_forms; eval of the rental fixture with sd.sold_other and sd.business_property true refuses f1040.line11a at sd.other_forms (Form 8824/4797/4684 outside the tool). An exchange of an earlier year is depreciated from the filer's existing schedule ($rprop help 'Your earlier depreciation schedule lists them').

unruled:rf4562#1.4.evidence: Same as rf4562#1.3, for line 19j (nonresidential real property placed in service in 2025): land excluded by rprop.basis and its help; placed-in-service date asked as first ready and available for rent (rprop.month/rprop.year); a 2025 like-kind exchange or involuntary conversion is refused at sd.other_forms (eval: sd.sold_other and sd.business_property true refuse f1040.line11a at sd.other_forms).

unruled:s179#1.1.evidence: p946 pp. 17-18; i4562 p. 5. Checked per property: a trade-in, like-kind exchange, involuntary conversion or purchase from a related person is asset.got_other ('Did you get it with a trade-in, in an exchange, ... from a relative or a business you control'), and use predominantly outside the United States is asset.outside_use; both make asset.screened true, which refuses the property. Land is real property, refused by asset.screened; land improvements, investment property, property bought and leased to others (with the noncorporate-lessor exceptions in the help) and use by exempt, governmental or foreign users are asset.not179, and an election on such property is refused by asset.s179_bad ('or it is not section 179 property'). The $31,300 heavy SUV cap is applied to vehicles (a scveh entry) by scveh.suv_cap and scveh.s179_bad. So no disqualified or traded-in cost reaches line 6.

unruled:s179#1.2.evidence: p946 pp. 18-19, Joint return after filing separate returns: 'If you and your spouse elect to amend your separate returns by filing a joint return after the due date'. That joint return replaces separate returns already filed, an amended return (Form 1040-X); the tool prepares the original 2025 return and asks nothing about earlier filings. A separate return with a section 179 election or carryover is itself refused (s179.mfs at s179.line5), so no separate return made by this tool carries an election. No gate names the amended case; residual accepted as before (earlier s179#1.4).

unruled:s179#1.3.evidence: i4562 p. 5; p946 p. 19, active conduct means meaningful participation. s179.income_sc sums person.income179, i.e. Schedule C line 31 before section 179 only. Every Schedule C is asked sc.passive (line G: 'did you yourself do all or most of the work of this business, or work in it more than 500 hours?', with the other material-participation tests in the help); a No makes sc.screened true and refuses the business. Material participation is a stricter test than meaningful participation, so every business counted is actively conducted. The one Yes not based on work, an oil or gas working interest, deducts depletion, which sc.special refuses (same gate). Other trades or businesses (partnerships, rentals, farms) are refused by scope.schedule1.

unruled:s179#1.4.evidence: p946 p. 19, the eight steps 'if you have a taxable income limit for some other deduction'. The steps are needed only when each limit depends on the other. i4562 p. 5, Line 11: business income is 'computed without regard to any section 179 expense deduction, the deduction for one-half of self-employment taxes ... or any net operating loss deduction'. It does not subtract self-employed retirement contributions (Schedule 1), so the SEP or SIMPLE limit (person.plan) is figured after line 12 in one pass, which is what the encoding does. The interdependent case this tool can reach, the home office simplified-method gross income limit together with the section 179 business income limit, is refused by sc.ho_both_limits at sc.ho_both ('Figuring two income-based limits in the order of Pub. 946 is outside this tool').

unruled:s1a#1.1.evidence: i1040gi p. 102. Every employee tip amount is a tipjob entry; for a listed occupation tipjob.charged (service charges, automatic gratuities, negotiated amounts, tips as tickets, meals or goods) and tipjob.unlawful (work against the law, prostitution or pornographic activity) feed tipjob.mixed, which refuses the employer's amount; tipjob.mixed reads tipjob.charged_if_listed, tipjob.other_work_if_listed and tipjob.unlawful_if_listed (current lines).

unruled:s1a#1.2.evidence: i1040gi p. 103. tipjob.listed asks whether the work is on the IRS list; tipjob.other_work_if_listed ('tips from this employer for other work that is not on that list') feeds tipjob.mixed, which refuses splitting one employer's tips, so mixed-occupation totals do not reach line 4a.

unruled:s1a#1.3.evidence: i1040gi p. 109. carloan.requirements asks origination after 2024, purchase (not a lease), first lien, unrelated lender, and expected personal use more than 50% by the filer or relatives or household members ('For a loan taken over at a death, they are those of the borrower who took it out'); carloan.vehicle asks new, made for public roads (not rails), car/minivan/van/SUV/pickup/motorcycle, GVWR under 14,000 pounds, final assembly in the United States. Writing the VIN on the return is filing information.

unruled:s1a#1.4.evidence: i1040gi pp. 109-110. carloan.col_iii subtracts carloan.col_ii (the part deducted elsewhere) from carloan.qpvli; s1a.line23 sums column (iii); carloan.refi_balance asks 'How much was still owed on the earlier loan on the day this loan replaced it?' for the refinancing limit; the qualifying-interest questions exclude negative equity, insurance and trailers (carloan.mixed / nonqualifying, as the earlier ruling, lines present).

unruled:s8812#1.1.evidence: i1040s8812 p. 3, Line 18a. The optional-method part is out of scope: person.se_screen names 'electing an optional method (Schedule SE Part II)' and person.se_screened refuses Schedule SE (person.se_line2). The treaty part is a gap: 'Income excluded under a tax treaty is also excluded from the computation of earned income on line 18a', and no line, screen or refusal in forms/2025 or interview/2025 mentions a treaty; the earlier ruling's s1.line8_other now reads only the deferred compensation and Olympic screens.

unruled:s8812#1.2.evidence: i1040s8812 p. 2; i1040gi p. 22. A child born and died in 2025 without an SSN is refused by dependent.claimed_no_tin (refusal on dependent.claimed: 'A dependent child who was born and died in 2025 without an SSN, entered as "Died" ... is outside this tool').

unruled:scveh#1.1.evidence: i1040sc p. 8, Line 20a, 'if you leased a vehicle for a term of 30 days or more, you may have to reduce your deduction by the inclusion amount'; p946 p. 59; p463 (2025), Inclusion Amounts, the amount applies if the vehicle's FMV when the lease began was more than $62,000 (2025 leases).
